items.note: Pure string fold; no new failure path. Merge stays fail-closed (a failing case wins).

items.note: No input surface change; the regex is linear (one greedy .* anchored at the end).

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: New test is red without the fix and asserts fold, fail-closed merge and case counts.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Greedy .* with a single end anchor, no nested quantifiers.
